# Source and local adaptations

Source: [obra/superpowers, `skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md).

License: [MIT](LICENSE), preserved verbatim from that commit.
Source SHA-256: `51c6435d98c83c42c96ba7c35725a0b2c376cd487fb1a4e6bd0ddbe7e33ef202`.

Echo rewrites the skill and adds explicit-only Codex metadata. Root-cause tracing,
working-example comparison, one-hypothesis checks and bounded repair attempts
remain. Dev/QA write and execution boundaries replace automatic implementation.
Generic instrumentation, mandatory per-fix test scaffolding, architectural
conclusions and upstream sub-skill dependencies are omitted. Verification uses
the repository sibling skill. No scripts, runtime or extra references are needed.

For updates, review the pinned source changes and Echo boundaries, preserve the
license, update the pin/hash and validate the skill, links and role profiles.
